facts.fact: The e-Government Authority (e-GA) said in November 2024 its NGAO multi-factor authentication system, using a one-time-password authenticator app, is being used on a trial basis by e-GA alone on the e-Office and ERMS systems, with the aim of extending it to other government systems.
The e-Government Authority (e-GA) said in November 2024 that it developed the NGAO multi-factor authentication system itself and uses it on a trial basis on the e-Office and ERMS systems.
